title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.title: George Kittle (Achilles) making 'terrific progress,' could play Week 1
items.desc: The 49ers are confident TE George Kittle will be ready for Week 1 against the Rams.
items.impact: Kittle suffered an Achilles tear during last year's postseason, leaving uncertainty about his status entering 2026. However, he appears to be making excellent progress in his recovery, leading San Francisco to believe he will suit up for Week 1. Kittle has been drafted as a low-end TE1 throughout the summer, but could see a rise in ADP with this news.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey Sermon signs with Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons signed RB Trey Sermon.
items.impact: Sermon appeared in four games with the Steelers last season. He will compete for a depth role in the Falcons backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) progressing, not cleared for team drills yet
items.desc: Malik Nabers continues to make progress, but he still wasn't participating in team drills on Monday.
items.impact: Stapleton notes that Nabers "looked to be opening up during his rehab work early and then with the training staff on opposite field as team drills went on." He was able to participate in position drills with the quarterbacks again as he continues to make progress.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quinnen Williams signs three-year extension with Cowboys
items.desc: The Cowboys and DL Quinnen Williams have agreed to terms on a three-year, $105.9M extension.
items.impact: The deal makes Williams one of the highest paid defensive lineman in the NFL. He was acquired in a trade from the Jets last season.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Christian McCaffrey sitting out Monday practice
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey is sitting out the 49ers practice on Monday due to "tightness."
items.impact: This is certainly not great news for fantasy managers who are relying on McCaffrey, and for 49ers fans who have already seen plenty of their stars go down. Of course, no reporting has said McCaffrey is missing any more time, but the fact that he's already experiencing some muscle tightness is concerning.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: J.K. Dobbins leaves Monday practice with trainers
items.desc: J.K. Dobbins left the Broncos practice on Monday with trainers.
items.impact: There's little information to follow after that. There could be an injury, but if it is, it's not readily apparent, which is a good thing. It's possible it was just cramps. So fantasy managers need to stay level headed while details are sparse, and wait for more info to make any sort of decisive action.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (muscle strain) not practicing Monday
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle remained absent from practice on Monday.
items.impact: Waddle went down in practice last week. Broncos coach Sean Payton said he expects him to return to practice this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Denzel Boston to practice with first-team offense
items.desc: Browns coach Todd Monken said rookie WR Denzel Boston will move into first-team offense.
items.impact: Boston continues to show out early on in training camp. He is slated to compete for an immediate starting role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jawaan Taylor expected to return to practice Monday
items.desc: Falcons coach Kevin Stefanski said he expects Jawaan Taylor to return to practice on Monday.
items.impact: Taylor opened training camp on the PUP list. He has been cleared to return to practice.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Worthy (shoulder) returns to practice Monday
items.desc: Xavier Worthy was back practicing at Chiefs training camp on Monday.
items.impact: Worthy missed time during practice last week. The Chiefs had their full wide receiver room on the field on Monday.
